item.title: Southwest flood damage estimates are hundreds of millions for New Mexico alone
item.description: Intense rainstorms linked to a very active El Niño-driven Pacific hurricane season have left thousands of people in the Four Corners states displaced.

item.title: A judge halted D.C. golf course renovations. Trump says they'll still start next month
item.description: A federal judge has barred the government from clearing more trees or making other alterations to D.C.'s East Potomac Park without proper notice. Trump says his administration will appeal.

item.title: Democrats still poised to make gains, but poll shows warning signs for just how many
item.description: Democrats hold significant advantages going into Election Day, according to a new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll. But lagging enthusiasm among key groups is just one indicator that gains may not come easy.

item.title: Can Black voting power and Trump fatigue break Mississippi's red wall?
item.description: Mississippi has the largest proportional Black population in the country. It's one reason the U.S. Senate race has seen millions in last-minute spending and high-profile campaign visits.

item.title: Some Michigan residents remain hopeful despite being hit hard by Trump's tariffs
item.description: Michigan households are paying the highest cost per household for the Trump administration's tariffs. For the voters paying the price, the issue isn't cut-and-dry.

item.title: As campaign rhetoric escalates, Michigan voters say they're burned out
item.description: From college football tailgates to conversations in Ann Arbor, Michigan voters tell NPR they're worried about everyday costs, frustrated with the two-party system and increasingly reluctant to discuss politics openly.

item.title: When an invasive fish is also tasty, Maryland schoolkids can help 'eat the problem'
item.description: The Chesapeake Bay, home to blue crabs and striped bass, has a new apex predator: the blue catfish. It's invasive and voracious. It's also delicious, which officials hope might help save the bay.
